rules.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.description: Detects exploitation of public-facing web applications, APIs, and services
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_mitre_t1190", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%public%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Application Layer Protocol Abuse (C2)
rules.description: Detects suspicious use of HTTP, DNS, or other application protocols for C2 communication
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_mitre_t1071", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
